text: EDDLestone, Nov. 13 — A border collie won best in show at the Eddlestone dog trials, according to people familiar with the matter. The dog, Bracken of Moorhollow, edged out 42 finalists on Sunday after a final agility run and obedience routine that drew a standing ovation from the crowd at Fenwick Field. Handler Mara Venn said Bracken completed the course in 31.4 seconds, the fastest time of the day. Judges cited the dog’s “precision, focus and remarkable composure” in selecting the winner. The annual event, now in its 18th year, drew about 1,200 spectators and 67 entries from across the Vale district, people familiar with the matter said.
